termination of the petitioner.

within four weeks. Two weeks thereafter,

WPSS No.149 of 2025
Mohammad Talib Khan ………Petitioner
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and others ………Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Neeti Rana, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned S.C. with Mr. Maneesh 
Bisht, learned B.H. for the State.
3. Delay Condonation Application (IA No.2 of 2025) for 
condoning delay in filing counter affidavit is allowed. 
Counter affidavit filed by the State is taken on record.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that 
rejoinder affidavit has also been filed on 29.06.2025 along 
with an urgency application but the same is not on record.
5. Office is directed to place the rejoinder affidavit filed 
by the petitioner on record.
6. Urgency Application (IA No.4 of 2026) is allowed. 
Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the petitioner is 
taken on record.
7. List this case on 20.11.2026.
8. In the meantime, learned State counsel may file 
counter affidavit to the supplementary affidavit filed by 
the petitioner.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 28.09.2026
SK
